text:
Ashlyn Ramos: Hey everyone! I’m Ashlyn — first day as PMM on Growth. I bring a very loud sourdough starter, a tiny pottery habit, and my corgi Mochi. Mostly remote but planning to be in the SF office Tue/Thu. Any tips for where to store clay or where to park a tiny kiln? :wave: :bread:
Mira Patel: Welcome Ashlyn!! Mochi pics pls :heart_eyes:
Talia Bhat: Welcome!! Desk assignments are on the seating chart in #people-ops. Also, there’s a casual ceramics meet on campus Tuesdays at lunch if you want to try a wheel (totally beginner friendly).
Noah Gameboy: hey hey — welcome! FYI we do a plant swap in the kitchen tomorrow at 11:30, perfect for a studio buddy. Free welcome lunch at 12 too :tada:
Ashlyn Ramos: ceramics meetup is real?? count me in. Mochi is very opinionated — attaching a terrible selfie: https://imgur.com/example (just a placeholder)
Luca: Badge will be ready by 10:30, stop by the security desk. I’ve also got a rolling dolly you can borrow for clay runs :truck:
welcome-bot: Reminder: complete HR onboarding checklist at https://redwood.example/onboard — due in 3 days
Talia Bhat: Quick poll — bringing a desk plant or nah? we generally avoid giant cacti (they stage dramatic exits) :seedling:
Ashlyn Ramos: Bringing a spider plant named "Spin" — she likes sunlight and indie podcasts.
Mira Patel: Also FYI there’s a small new-hire mingle Friday at 4pm in the lobby (snacks + dog treats). Mochi will be celebrity. :dog: :balloon:
Noah Gameboy: Mochi welcome party confirmed. Please bring snacks that are dog-safe. :yum:
Ashlyn Ramos: yay! grateful for the warm welcome, excited to meet y’all in person :sparkles:
Luca: Ping me if you want a mic for demos or need help with setup. Also, we have a communal cart for heavy things — happy to drop it off at your desk."
